run_clustering_initialization: run FAISS clustering initialization with RANDOM, KMEANS++, or AFK-MC2 methods to get centroids
generate_clustered_data: generate well-separated synthetic clustered data for testing k-means initialization algorithms
verify_centroids_from_dataset: verify that computed centroids are close to actual data points in the dataset
verify_centroids_unique: verify that all initialized centroids are unique with no duplicates using knn search
test_clustering_initialization_determini: test that clustering initialization produces identical centroids when given the same random seed
